description:
The University of Manitoba was founded in 1877. It is located in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada. It is the state's largest university. The University of Manitoba has more than 130,000 students, approximately 13% of whom are international students. It is a university preferred by students from over 100 countries. There are instructors from many parts of the world. The campus is in Canada. It is one of the suitable places. It is a research-intensive university. Classes are small to be more interested in students' education. It is the university where students receive the most awards in Western Canada. It has 2 main campuses, Fort Garry and Bannatyne. The University of Manitoba is in the top 400 according to Times Higher Education and in the top 650 according to QS in the world rankings.

Note: Courses may be requested depending on the department you are applying for. For details, please contact Collab International.

You can get to know the University of Manitoba better by staying in their dormitories. You can make long-lasting friendships, see students from almost all classes and from different countries of the world. More than 1,350 students choose to stay in the University of Manitoba's residence halls each year. University of Manitoba’s dorms offer single rooms or shared rooms, and the average fee in is between 8,700-14,000 CAD. Fees are valid for the academic year and meals are included.
